detail: Issue of Securities - Share India Securities Limited has informed the Exchange that pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please be informed that the Finance Committee, at its meeting held today i.e., July 20, 2026, have approved the issuance of up to 1,50,000 secured, rated, listed, taxable, transferable, redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures of face value of Rs. 10,000/- each, on a private placement basis.
